title: tungtungmod
description: I made this mod specifically for Tungtungsahur.
body:
This mod is a personal commission built from the ground up for Tungtungsahur.

It doesn't follow general balancing rules or common community preferences. Every tweak, every rework, and every visual change serves a single purpose: to match the exact gameplay vision of Tungtungsahur.

Think of it as a custom-tailored suit in a world of off-the-rack modifications. It fits perfectly, but only for one person.

For everyone else: This is probably unbalanced, weird, or even broken. But it's not for everyone else.
